title: Execute a device-authorized Take over a scope-only Show-level route

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0088 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-25 directive 'dale' approving the design's slice 2 (Take execution) after the scope-only-authorization approach was surfaced and accepted. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0088.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors, SPEC-0001 REQ-INT-002 / US-010, and the 2026-08-25 user directive plus the surfaced approach.

claims.statement: A new POST /api/device/shows/:showId/production/take promotes Preview to Program for a device credential. Take is a Show-level action with no per-control binding, so it is authorized scope-only: the route authenticates the bearer token, then requires authority.showId === the route Show and authority.scopes.includes('production:take') — mirroring the catalog GET route rather than lifecycle.authorize (which requires a controlId). This is consistent with CHG-0087's scope-only Take discovery. The body is exactly { operationId, expectedPreviewRevision } and is wired to ProductionService.take; the response is the resulting production state. ShowTakeActionDescriptor gained an input { expectedPreviewRevision } so discovery and execution agree.
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/deviceControl.ts take route and takeBody; protocol/src/control-action-catalog.ts ShowTakeActionDescriptor.input; the catalog route it mirrors.

claims.statement: An adversarial security review (authz-boundary, correctness, audit-durability lenses with per-finding verification) found NO authorization bypass — a token without production:take, or for another Show, is correctly denied 403 before any mutation. It confirmed two non-bypass defects, now fixed: the insufficient_scope challenge hardcoded the visibility scope, so a Take denial advertised the wrong required scope (now the challenge names production:take via a threaded scope); and takeBody did not validate expectedPreviewRevision, so a non-integer fell through take()'s strict comparison to a misleading 409 instead of a clean 400 (now validated at the route like the studio and visibility paths).
claims.evidence: the CHG-0088 security review; server/src/routes/deviceControl.ts challenge/respondAuthorizationForbidden scope threading and takeBody revision guard; server/tests/unit/deviceControlHttp.test.ts new assertions on the challenge scope and the non-integer 400.

claims.statement: This slice mutates durable production state but does NOT route the Take through the signed device command journal that device visibility commands use (executeDeviceVisibilityCommand): a device Take gets no signed ProductionCommandRecord / globalSequence audit entry, and its operationId idempotency is in-memory only, so a replay across a process restart could double-promote. The review judged this an acceptable, clearly-bounded gap for a discovery-then-execution staging, not a blocker. Durable, signed, restart-safe Take is a deferred slice (it closes the audit and restart-dedup gaps together).
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/deviceControl.ts (production.take, not executeDeviceVisibilityCommand); the audit-durability review verdict; the frontier remainder node companion-catalog-take-trigger-actions.

claims.statement: Additive: a new device route and a descriptor input field. No Studio change, no adapter change, and no signed-frame or visibility change — Take still does not appear in signed frames. Frame-level Take, adapter/module consumption of the Take action, durable/signed Take execution, and Scene/trigger actions remain deferred.
claims.evidence: git diff of the CHG-0088 branch: server/src/routes/deviceControl.ts and protocol/src/control-action-catalog.ts and their tests; the deferred frontier nodes.

successCriteria.statement: A production:take credential promotes Preview to Program via the device Take route; a visibility-only credential and a wrong-Show credential are denied without mutating Program.
successCriteria.verification: server/tests/unit/deviceControlHttp.test.ts asserts the 200 promote (program revision 1 to 2), and 403 for missing scope and wrong Show with unchanged program revision.

successCriteria.statement: A Take denial advertises the production:take scope, and a malformed Take body (extra key or non-integer revision) is a clean 400.
successCriteria.verification: Tests assert the WWW-Authenticate challenge contains scope="production:take" and that an extra key and a string revision both yield 400.
The full protocol and server suites pass; the visibility route's challenge scope is unchanged by the threaded default.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0088 records the scope-only authorization, the security-review fixes, and the deferred durable/signed/audit bound before implementation of the record.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: The device Take route authorizes scope-only, validates its body, promotes Preview to Program, and names the correct scope on denial.
Tests prove the promote, the scope and Show denials, the challenge scope, and the malformed-body 400; the full suites pass.
Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, tests, build, dependency and diff checks pass before handoff.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, ESLint, type-check and git diff --check; the accept commit is verified by its own pull-request Constitution run before merge.
